# Session Primer

## What This Project Does

Compiles West Nile virus mosquito trap data from multiple surveillance contractors (VDCI, CMC, CFC,
Boulder County, 2006–present) into a single rectangular dataset where every trap × week × species
cell is accounted for — distinguishing a true zero catch from a trap that was never set out.

## How to Run It

Open `pipelines/pipeline_combine_culex_sheet.qmd` in RStudio and click **Render**, or:

```r
quarto::quarto_render("pipelines/pipeline_combine_culex_sheet.qmd")
```

The main output is `3_output/culex_sheet_database_expand.csv`.

## How the Pieces Fit Together

Four raw source folders (`1_input/vdci/`, `cmc/`, `cfc/`, `bc/`) are read by `read_source()`,
each file optionally reshaped by a pivot function (`pivot_cmc`, `pivot_cfc`, `pivot_boulder`).
The canonical cleaning chain (`key_rename` → `wnv_s_clean` → `make_key` → `culex_dedup`) runs on
each source independently, then `prep_for_skeleton()` expands every observed trap-week to have one
row per species. Sources with `filter_active: true` are semi-joined against the `foco_trap`
registry to keep only known-active traps. `expand_trap()` builds the rectangular skeleton and
`fill_skeleton()` joins all sources in strict priority (VDCI > CMC > CFC > BC > database). The
historical `wnv-s_database` fills any remaining gaps. `assign_trap_status_post_expand()` resolves
remaining NA trap_status cells, and 6 `stopifnot()` assertions guard data integrity before the
final CSV is written.

## Common Gotchas

- **Source paths are flat, not nested.** Input files now live directly in `1_input/vdci/`,
  `1_input/cmc/`, etc. — not inside `WNV-s YYYY/Week WW/` subdirectories. The manifest inventory
  (`inventory_source()`) reflects this; `inventory_week_folders()` no longer exists.
- **Config `pattern` keys are regexes**, not shell globs. Use `\\.csv$`, not `*.csv`.
- **Boulder (`bc`) is not filtered** (`filter_active: false`) — BC traps are not in `foco_trap`.
- **CFC needs `import_args: {sheet: "CombinedData"}`** — the XLSX has multiple sheets.
- **`prep_for_skeleton()` must run before `fill_skeleton()`** — the skeleton expects one row per
  spp_level per trap-week; skipping prep will produce NA cells that fail the post-expand assertions.
- **`_manifest.txt` is untracked** — it is never committed to git (lives in `3_output/`). Check it
  after each run to confirm expected file counts and row counts per stage.
- **`zone2`** collapses Fort Collins NE/NW/SE/SW → `"FC"` and passes BE/LV/BC through unchanged.
  Functions that plot by zone (`plot_n_trap`) use `zone2`, not `zone`.
